name: President Kozak

tenures.source: The fed's own founder and on-screen president throughout its 1998 run, self-billed in every recruitment post and staged in-fiction as a run-in heel authority at Slammin' Saturday Night (23 May 1998), stepping down as president by mid-July and returning as owner by August.

caption: The fed's own founder and on-air president, who interfered with a baseball bat to cost a wrestler his Hardcore Tournament match before stepping down mid-1998.

name: President Nikithser

tenures.source: Succeeded the fed's founder as president in early July 1998, self-billed on-air at a desk in "KoZaK Plaza" for the fed's own Trash Talk broadcast.

caption: The fed's own vice president, promoted to president in a July 1998 front-office transfer announced on the fed's own Trash Talk broadcast.

name: Lucy Law

tenures.source: The fed's own first female wrestler, defeating Rich Jericho in the opening round of the Hardcore Title Tournament at Slammin' Saturday Night.

caption: Billed as the fed's own first female wrestler, opening the Hardcore Title Tournament with a full-nelson slam win over Rich Jericho.

name: Rich Jericho

tenures.source: Lost the Hardcore Title Tournament's opening match to Lucy Law at Slammin' Saturday Night.

caption: A veteran wrestler who dropped the fed's own Hardcore Title Tournament's opening match to Lucy Law.

name: GODSEND

tenures.source: Stepped in for a suspended Road House in the Hardcore Title Tournament, losing to Eric Fox after the fed's own president interfered with a baseball bat.

caption: A late substitute in the fed's own Hardcore Title Tournament, beaten only after the president's own bat shot to the back of his head.

name: Eric Fox

tenures.source: Advanced in the Hardcore Title Tournament over GODSEND (with the president's own interference) and wrestled again the same night in a mixed tag exhibition alongside Sam Ramey.

caption: Advanced past GODSEND in the Hardcore Title Tournament with the fed president's own help, then wrestled a mixed tag exhibition the same night.

name: Jimmy "Me Smash"

tenures.source: Advanced through the Hardcore Title Tournament over Ian Duncan, and by mid-July had gone on to defeat EWO mainstay Titan for the fed's own World Championship at a pay-per-view called Hardcore Heaven.

caption: A powerhouse who advanced through the fed's own Hardcore Title Tournament before beating Titan for the World Championship at Hardcore Heaven.

name: Ian Duncan

tenures.source: Lost the Hardcore Title Tournament's opening round to Jimmy "Me Smash."

caption: A relative newcomer eliminated from the fed's own Hardcore Title Tournament by Jimmy "Me Smash."

name: Assault

tenures.source: The smaller member of the stable Death Row, lost the Hardcore Title Tournament's opening round to Ragnarok.

caption: The smaller half of the stable Death Row, dropped from the Hardcore Title Tournament in its opening round by Ragnarok.

name: Ragnarok

tenures.source: Won the Hardcore Title Tournament's opening round over Assault of the stable Death Row.

caption: Advanced through the fed's own Hardcore Title Tournament's opening round over Assault.

name: Sandra "The Horrible" Maria

tenures.source: Debuted as half of the fed's own first female tag team, BFF, winning a mixed tag exhibition over Sam Ramey and Eric Fox.

caption: Half of the fed's own first female tag team, BFF, debuting with a win in a mixed tag exhibition.

name: Carissa Marsh

tenures.source: Debuted as half of the fed's own first female tag team, BFF, winning a mixed tag exhibition over Sam Ramey and Eric Fox.

caption: Half of the fed's own first female tag team, BFF, debuting with a win in a mixed tag exhibition.

name: Sam Ramey

tenures.source: Lost a mixed tag exhibition alongside Eric Fox to the fed's own debuting female tag team, BFF.

caption: Half of a veteran tag team beaten by the fed's own debuting female tag team, BFF, in a mixed exhibition.
